dicai_addition: Reusable-principle style instructions are a CAISO addition; whole requests also use structured task data and additional schema guidance.
historical_scope: Pre-paper-prompt migration. DICAI pre-consolidation and request-parity findings describe the historical baseline, not current DICAI requests.

current_caiso_method.style: Named agents, numbered tasks, requirements, explicit JSON response formats and labeled user evidence, following DICAI formatting.
current_caiso_method.source: CAISO-authored method instructions; not transcriptions of the DICAI paper.
current_caiso_method.preserved: Existing method inputs, output fields, selection criteria, workflow restrictions, tips, personas, configuration values and benchmark prompts. Preference layouts now use trajectory headings.
current_caiso_method.normal_stage_schema_messages: Response formats live in the complete stage templates; duplicate schema supplements disabled for the three stages.

method_response_recovery.normal_prompt_text: Original code-based complete requests with the documented minimal trajectory adaptations; no separate seed-drafting prompt.
method_response_recovery.principle_wording: Requires Select the trajectory followed by an actual criterion, preserving equivalent where/that/which/with/in which wording and component identifiers. Grammatical variations do not trigger retries; empty criteria, placeholders, bare A/B choices and old response-style prefixes remain invalid. Prompt text is unchanged.
method_response_recovery.repair: Includes the invalid assistant response before the format-repair instruction; raw response and call context are logged. Principle validation errors no longer include a copyable placeholder criterion.
method_response_recovery.request_checkpoints: Successful DICAI requests are saved under each induction provenance directory and validated on reuse.

previous_paper_protocol.title: Democratic ICAI: Debating Our Way to Steering Principles from Preferences
previous_paper_protocol.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (paper; original code remains MIT)
previous_paper_protocol.transcription: Published wording, with TeX layout/list markers normalized for plain text.
previous_paper_protocol.result: Appendix G Figures 10–16 minimally adapted to trajectory comparisons; Figure 16 judging unchanged. No reconstruction gate, minimum-principle rule or structured component constitution schema.
adaptations: Three configured QA/recommendation persona profiles, rather than creative-writing personas.
Dynamic CAISO task/trajectory evidence and turn counters supplied in user messages.
Existing transports, temperatures, clustering and optional post-induction minimization retained.
Generic response validation/retries remain; no extra schema message on a valid DICAI request.

A separate CAISO-authored question-drafting request extracts candidate criteria from each persona rationale to seed the working list, as expected by the original debate code; three additional budgeted and checkpointed method calls per pair.

candidate_question_prompt.source: CAISO-authored bridge; not an Appendix G transcription
candidate_question_prompt.purpose: Initialize persona proposals and the shared working list from rationale-grounded criteria instead of empty lists.

runtime_adaptation.reasoning: Published system instructions and final_reasoning schema unchanged; evidence headings use trajectory terminology.
runtime_adaptation.debate: Story/human-choice wording becomes trajectory/provided-preference wording; principles begin Select the trajectory where. One sentence permits individual component behavior, component interactions or final output criteria.
runtime_adaptation.abstraction: Trajectory principle prefix and one requirement preserving input component references and distinctions.
runtime_adaptation.judging: Complete Figure 16 instructions, Output(a)/Output(b) labels and random fallback unchanged.
runtime_adaptation.format: Plain string principles; drafting, parsing and repair feedback use the same trajectory prefix.
runtime_adaptation.reference: Original LaTeX and reference transcription fixture remain unmodified.

Abstraction preserves component references and distinctions (one sentence).

current_dicai.runtime: Original structured rationales/questions, sampled consensus, iterative refinement, reconstruction status and finalization gates, JSON 1/2 judging, singleton abstraction bypass.
current_dicai.audit: Template imported; no new auditor model or automatic audit stage enabled.
current_dicai.preserved: All existing numeric configuration values, model routes, benchmark prompts, datasets, metrics and dataset personas.
